technical.summary: Multiple short-term bullish confluences (SMA golden cross, hull flip, volume spike) offset by weak trend strength (low ADX), negative money flow (CMF), and long-term bearish structure—suitable for tactical swing but elevated risk.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (391.84) with FOMC event just passed creates severe near-term volatility headwind; normal yield curve and flat DXY provide limited offset; 88-day earnings window mitigates binary event risk but macro conditions are highly unfavourable.

debate.key_bull_argument: SMA 9/21 golden cross + Hull flip + 15x volume spike create tactical short-term confluence in extreme fear regime (VIX crisis), offering contrarian entry near support (115.75) with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Weak trend strength (ADX false), negative money flow (CMF false), long-term bearish structure (below 50/200 EMAs), zero fundamental/smart money support, and macro crisis volatility (post-FOMC) overwhelm short-term technicals and create unfavourable risk/reward.
